concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-development-resources-batch-processing-advanced-sftp-batch-files-batch-result-file-accountupdater-result-file]] — 2020-modified Account Updater result-file `L`/`SL` schema for batch, automatic and real-time variants, conditional PAN/PGP, and result-versus-payment boundaries (2026-09-15 snapshot).
warnings: Sub-line field 4 in the raw assigns PSP reference by L request type but merchant reference when SL type is AccountUpdaterResult; those rules overlap for scheduled batch results and are not reconciled.

Batch Account Updater parent guide broadly calls its result file encrypted, whereas this schema conditions encryption and states unencrypted files omit PAN; preserve the conditional rule for this file.
